text:
The response finds the most serious bug, `Invalidate` deleting from a map under a read lock, which is a real data race that can crash the process, and ranks it first with the correct fix. The stale re-caching race (item 2), the stampede (3), unbounded growth from never-removed expired entries (5), and the missing timeout or context on `fetch` (6) are all real problems in this code. The TTL concern (4) is speculative because the code gives no token lifetime, but it is a reasonable design concern for "short-lived" tokens. Most items name a fix, though item 2 lacks one (a generation counter or per-tenant version would work) and item 6 doesn't say to pass a context. It avoids flagging fine code and stays close to the 200-word limit. It misses nothing major, though it doesn't mention that `Get` overwrites a freshly cached entry written by a concurrent miss.

Score: 8
